summary.en: Students explore what drama is, its purpose, and basic classroom conventions for participating safely and respectfully in drama activities.
summary.fr: Les élèves explorent ce qu'est le théâtre, son but, et les conventions de base pour participer en toute sécurité et avec respect aux activités théâtrales.
summary.mfe: Bann elev explor ki eski drama ete, so bi, ek bann konvansion baz pou partisip an sekirite ek avek respe dan bann aktivite drama.

objectives: Define drama and identify its key elements
Distinguish drama from everyday behaviour
Discuss where drama can be found in Mauritian life
Explain the importance of trust and safety in drama
Demonstrate respectful listening during group work
Follow classroom conventions such as freeze and focus
Perform simple physical and vocal warm-up exercises
Explain why warm-ups prepare the body and mind
Participate cooperatively in group energiser games

summary.en: This unit introduces vocal skills such as projection, pace, pitch and tone, helping students communicate clearly and expressively.
summary.fr: Cette unité présente des compétences vocales telles que la projection, le rythme, la hauteur et le ton, aidant les élèves à communiquer clairement.
summary.mfe: Sa linite la introdir bann konpetans vokal kouma proteksion son, vites, oter ek ton, ki ed bann elev kominik kler ek expresif.

objectives: Explain what vocal projection means
Practise speaking clearly to a large space
Identify factors affecting audibility
Define pace, pitch and tone in speech
Experiment with vocal variety to convey emotion
Recognise how tone changes meaning
Perform a short text as a group using unison and echo
Coordinate timing and rhythm with peers
Reflect on group vocal performance

summary.en: Students learn how posture, gesture and movement communicate character and feeling without words, building physical awareness for performance.
summary.fr: Les élèves apprennent comment la posture, le geste et le mouvement communiquent le caractère et les émotions sans mots.
summary.mfe: Bann elev aprann kouma postir, zes ek mouvman kominik karakter ek santiman san servi mo.

objectives: Identify how posture and gesture convey meaning
Demonstrate different emotions through stance
Observe and describe peers' body language
Define mime and its uses in drama
Create imaginary objects and actions through mime
Perform a short mime sequence
Explore levels, speed and direction in movement
Use space effectively to avoid collisions
Create a short movement sequence in groups

summary.en: This unit introduces students to taking on roles, exploring characters different from themselves, and building simple scenes.
summary.fr: Cette unité initie les élèves à endosser des rôles, à explorer des personnages différents d'eux-mêmes et à construire des scènes simples.
summary.mfe: Sa linite introdir bann elev pou pran rol, explor personaz diferan ar zot ek konstrir bann senn senp.

objectives: Explain the concept of role play in drama
Adopt a simple role using voice and movement
Reflect on how it feels to play a character
Identify features that build a character such as age, job and personality
Develop a character profile
Present a character to the class briefly

title.fr: Scènes simples de jeu de rôle

objectives: Collaborate to create a short role play scene
Use dialogue appropriate to the character
Give and receive constructive feedback

summary.en: Students develop spontaneous performance skills by responding to prompts, building scenes together and thinking creatively under pressure.
summary.fr: Les élèves développent des compétences de performance spontanée en répondant à des consignes et en créant des scènes ensemble.
summary.mfe: Bann elev devlop konpetans perform spontane par reponn a bann prompt ek kree senn ansam.

objectives: Define improvisation and its role in drama
Practise responding quickly to simple prompts
Discuss the importance of listening in improvisation
Explain the yes and rule of improvisation
Build a scene by accepting and adding ideas
Avoid blocking a partner's ideas
Use everyday objects imaginatively in a scene
Create short improvised scenes in pairs
Evaluate the effectiveness of an improvised scene

title.fr: Raconter des histoires par le théâtre

summary.en: This unit explores how stories, including Mauritian folktales, can be brought to life through dramatic techniques and structure.
summary.fr: Cette unité explore comment les histoires, y compris les contes mauriciens, peuvent prendre vie grâce aux techniques théâtrales.
summary.mfe: Sa linite explor kouma bann zistwar, ki ensor bann conte morisien, kapav pran lavi atraver bann teknik dramatik.

objectives: Identify beginning, middle and end in a story
Explain how conflict drives a dramatic story
Sequence events of a familiar story
Select key events from a local folktale for performance
Assign roles and plan a short dramatisation
Perform a scene based on the folktale
Explain the use of narration in storytelling drama
Create still images called tableaux to represent moments
Combine narration and tableaux in a short piece

summary.en: Students are introduced to key dramatic elements such as tension, contrast and symbol, learning to apply them in simple performances.
summary.fr: Les élèves découvrent des éléments dramatiques clés tels que la tension, le contraste et le symbole, et apprennent à les appliquer.
summary.mfe: Bann elev aprann bann element dramatik kle kouma tansion, kontras ek senbol, ek aprann aplik zot dan bann perform senp.

objectives: Define tension and contrast as dramatic elements
Identify tension in a short scene
Create a scene using contrast between characters
Explain how symbols convey meaning in drama
Use focus to highlight important action on stage
Apply symbol and focus in a group exercise
Combine multiple dramatic elements in a short scene
Plan a performance using tension, contrast and symbol
Reflect on the impact of these elements on an audience

summary.en: In this culminating unit, students devise and rehearse a short group performance, then present it and reflect on their learning journey.
summary.fr: Dans cette unité finale, les élèves créent et répètent une courte performance de groupe, puis la présentent et réfléchissent à leur apprentissage.
summary.mfe: Dan sa dernie linite, bann elev devlop ek repete enn ti perform an group, apre prezant li ek refleshi lor zot laprantisaz.

objectives: Collaborate in groups to devise an original short scene
Use skills learnt throughout the unit such as mime and improvisation
Plan roles and responsibilities within the group
Practise a scene with attention to voice and movement
Give constructive feedback to peers during rehearsal
Refine a scene based on feedback
Perform a devised scene confidently to an audience
Demonstrate respect and support for peer performers
Reflect on personal growth as a drama learner

title.fr: Retour sur les bases du théâtre

summary.en: Students revise key drama vocabulary and warm-up techniques learnt in Grade 7 before building on them with more complex exercises.
summary.fr: Les élèves révisent le vocabulaire théâtral clé et les techniques d'échauffement apprises en 7e année avant de les approfondir avec des exercices plus complexes.
summary.mfe: Bann elev revize vokabiler teat inportan ek teknik esofman ki zot finn aprann Grade 7 avan zot devlop ar exersis pli konplike.

objectives: Recall key drama terms such as mime, improvisation and characterisation
Match terms to short practical examples
Discuss how these terms were used in earlier work
Lead a group through a familiar warm-up sequence
Explain the purpose of physical and vocal warm-ups
Adapt a warm-up game to include a new rule

title.fr: Développer la confiance et la concentration

objectives: Participate in trust-building exercises safely
Demonstrate sustained focus during group activity
Reflect on the importance of ensemble trust in drama

summary.en: This unit develops students' ability to create believable characters through physicality, voice and status.
summary.fr: Cette unité développe la capacité des élèves à créer des personnages crédibles à travers la corporalité, la voix et le statut.
summary.mfe: Sa linite-la devlop kapasite bann elev pou kree personaz kredib atraver lekor, lavwa ek statu.

objectives: Experiment with posture, walk and gesture to show character traits
Observe and describe physical choices made by peers
Apply feedback to refine a character's physicality
Vary pitch, pace and tone to suggest different characters
Perform a short line in three contrasting voices
Explain how vocal choices affect audience perception
Define high and low status through body language
Improvise a scene showing a shift in status
Analyse how status affects a scene's meaning

title.fr: La technique de la chaise chaude

objectives: Prepare background details for an invented character
Answer questions in role, staying consistent
Give constructive feedback on peers' role portrayals

summary.en: Students practise spontaneous and structured improvisation to build confidence and creative thinking on stage.
summary.fr: Les élèves pratiquent l'improvisation spontanée et structurée pour développer la confiance et la pensée créative sur scène.
summary.mfe: Bann elev pratik improvizasion spontane ek striktire pou devlop konfians ek panse kreatif lor sen.

objectives: State the basic rules of successful improvisation
Practise accepting offers in a short scene
Identify moments where an offer was blocked
Transform an everyday object into something imaginative
Build a short scene around an imagined object
Justify creative choices to the group
Contribute ideas to build a collective story in role
Maintain narrative coherence during improvisation
Reflect on collaboration skills used

summary.en: Students explore local legends, folk tales and community stories, adapting them into short dramatic scenes.
summary.fr: Les élèves explorent des légendes locales, des contes populaires et des histoires communautaires, en les adaptant en courtes scènes dramatiques.
summary.mfe: Bann elev explor bann lezand lokal, kont popiler ek zistwar kominote, adapte zot an ti sen dramatik.

objectives: Gather a short folk tale or family story from home
Summarise the story's key events
Identify potential characters for dramatisation
Select a key moment from a story to dramatise
Plan dialogue and actions for the scene
Assign roles within a small group
Rehearse a scene using blocking and timing
Incorporate cultural details respectfully into performance
Give and receive peer feedback during rehearsal
Perform a rehearsed scene for classmates
Explain choices made in adapting the story
Reflect on audience reactions to the performance

summary.en: This unit focuses on stage geography, levels and movement to strengthen visual storytelling.
summary.fr: Cette unité se concentre sur la géographie de la scène, les niveaux et le mouvement pour renforcer la narration visuelle.
summary.mfe: Sa linite-la konsantre lor zeografi lasenn, nivo ek mouvman pou ranforsi rakonte istwar par lizie.

objectives: Identify the main areas of a stage
Move purposefully between stage areas
Explain why stage position affects audience focus
Create varied levels using body positions
Compose a still image representing a theme
Discuss how levels create visual interest

title.fr: Le mouvement pour exprimer les émotions

objectives: Use movement quality to show different emotions
Perform a short movement sequence in a group
Give feedback using appropriate drama vocabulary

summary.en: Students learn to read, interpret and perform short scripted extracts, focusing on script conventions.
summary.fr: Les élèves apprennent à lire, interpréter et jouer de courts extraits scénarisés, en se concentrant sur les conventions de script.
summary.mfe: Bann elev aprann lir, interprete ek zwe ti extre ekri, konsantre lor konvansion skrip.

objectives: Identify stage directions and dialogue in a script
Explain the purpose of stage directions
Read a short extract aloud with expression
Interpret a character's intention from dialogue
Rehearse a short scripted scene in pairs
Adjust delivery based on director feedback

title.fr: Mettre en scène un extrait scénarisé

objectives: Plan entrances, exits and movement for a scene
Follow simple stage directions accurately
Collaborate with peers to finalise blocking
Perform a short scripted extract for an audience
Stay in character throughout the performance
Reflect on strengths and areas to improve

title.fr: Le théâtre pour la sensibilisation sociale

summary.en: Students use drama techniques such as forum theatre and tableaux to explore social issues relevant to their community.
summary.fr: Les élèves utilisent des techniques théâtrales telles que le théâtre-forum et les tableaux vivants pour explorer des questions sociales pertinentes pour leur communauté.
summary.mfe: Bann elev servi teknik teat kouma teat-forum ek tablivan pou explor bann problem sosial ki konsern zot kominote.

objectives: Create a frozen image representing a social issue
Interpret meaning from peers' tableaux
Explain choices of gesture and positioning

title.fr: Explorer des problèmes à travers le rôle

objectives: Take on a role to explore a social issue respectfully
Respond in character to questions from peers
Reflect on different perspectives shown
Explain the purpose of forum theatre
Suggest alternative actions during a scene
Participate respectfully as audience-actors

title.fr: Présenter une scène sur un problème social
title.mfe: Prezant enn sen lor problem sosial

objectives: Devise a short scene addressing a chosen issue
Perform the scene sensitively for classmates
Lead a brief discussion following the performance

summary.en: Students build on earlier improvisation skills, learning to sustain longer scenes, respond to unexpected challenges, and work collaboratively to create believable dramatic moments.
summary.fr: Les élèves développent leurs compétences antérieures en improvisation, apprenant à maintenir des scènes plus longues, à réagir à des défis inattendus et à collaborer pour créer des moments dramatiques crédibles.
summary.mfe: Bann elev devlop zot bann konpetans improvizasion ki zot ti gagne avan, aprann pou maintenir bann sxenn pli long, reponn a bann defi initenn ek travay ansam pou kree bann moman dramatik kredib.

objectives: Develop a scene beyond its opening idea
Maintain character consistency over time
Build a scene with a clear beginning, middle and end
Demonstrate high and low status through body and voice
Shift status during a scene to create tension
Analyse how status affects relationships on stage
Accept and build on unexpected offers from a partner
Stay in character when plans change
Use quick thinking to keep a scene believable
Collaborate with three or more performers in one scene
Share focus fairly among group members
Reflect on group dynamics after a performance

summary.en: This unit explores how actors build believable characters using physicality, voice, backstory and motivation, moving from simple role play to deeper character study.
summary.fr: Cette unité explore comment les acteurs construisent des personnages crédibles en utilisant la physicalité, la voix, l'historique et la motivation, passant du simple jeu de rôle à une étude de personnage plus approfondie.
summary.mfe: Sa lini-la explor kouma bann akter konstrir bann personaz kredib par servi lekor, lavwa, listwar ek motivasion, pass depi enn senp role play ver enn letid personaz pli fon.

objectives: Use posture, gesture and gait to define a character
Experiment with physical traits for different ages and roles
Perform a short walk-in exercise to show character
Adapt pitch, pace and tone to suit a character
Explore accents and speech patterns respectfully
Perform a monologue showing vocal characterisation
Create a backstory for an assigned character
Identify a character's wants and needs in a scene
Justify character choices using backstory details

title.fr: La technique de la chaise chaude

objectives: Answer questions in role to deepen character knowledge
Ask probing questions to explore another character
Reflect on new insights gained through hot-seating

summary.en: Learners examine the key elements of drama such as tension, contrast, symbol and climax, and how these combine to shape a piece of theatre.
summary.fr: Les élèves examinent les éléments clés du théâtre tels que la tension, le contraste, le symbole et le point culminant, et comment ceux-ci se combinent pour façonner une pièce de théâtre.
summary.mfe: Bann elev examinn bann elema kle teat kouma tansion, kontras, senbol ek klimaks, ek kouma sa bann la konbine pou form enn pyes teat.

title.fr: Tension et contraste dans le théâtre

objectives: Identify tension and contrast in performed scenes
Create a scene that builds tension gradually
Use contrast to highlight a dramatic moment
Recognise symbolic objects and actions in performance
Design a symbolic gesture to represent an idea
Explain the meaning behind a chosen symbol
Sequence events to build toward a climax
Identify climax points in a known story
Perform a scene that reaches a clear climax

title.fr: La structure dramatique dans les courtes pièces
title.mfe: Striktir dramatik dan bann ti pyes

objectives: Outline exposition, conflict and resolution in a short play
Compare structures across two different stories
Create a structure plan for an original scene

title.fr: Créer du théâtre à partir d'un stimulus

summary.en: Students learn the devising process, turning a picture, news story, object or theme into an original piece of theatre through collaborative creation.
summary.fr: Les élèves apprennent le processus de création théâtrale, transformant une image, un fait divers, un objet ou un thème en une pièce de théâtre originale grâce à une création collaborative.
summary.mfe: Bann elev aprann prosesis kreasion teat, transform enn zimaz, enn lartik nouvel, enn obze ouswa enn tem an enn pyes teat orizinal atraver kreasion kolektiv.

objectives: Generate ideas from a picture, object or article
Brainstorm possible scenes from a single stimulus
Select the strongest idea for development
Organise ideas into a sequence of scenes
Assign roles and responsibilities within a group
Rehearse a devised scene with clear staging

title.en: Using local themes in devised work
title.fr: Utiliser des thèmes locaux dans le travail créé
title.mfe: Servi bann tem lokal dan travay devlope

objectives: Draw on Mauritian culture or events as inspiration
Represent diverse perspectives respectfully in a scene
Discuss the relevance of local themes to audiences

title.fr: Affiner et présenter le travail créé

objectives: Give and receive feedback to improve a scene
Refine transitions and timing in a devised piece
Present a finished devised scene to an audience

title.fr: Explorer des scripts et des dramaturges

summary.en: This unit introduces reading and interpreting scripts, understanding stage directions, and exploring the work of playwrights from Mauritius and beyond.
summary.fr: Cette unité initie à la lecture et à l'interprétation de scripts, à la compréhension des indications scéniques et à l'exploration du travail de dramaturges de Maurice et d'ailleurs.
summary.mfe: Sa lini-la introdir lir ek interprete skrip, konpran bann direksion lasenn ek explor travay bann dramatiz depi Moris ek lezot pei.

objectives: Identify stage directions and dialogue in a script
Interpret a character's intentions from the text
Read a script extract aloud with expression
Identify well-known Mauritian playwrights and their work
Discuss themes common in local plays
Compare a local script extract to a foreign one
Block movement for a short scripted scene
Make acting choices based on script clues
Perform a scripted extract with a partner
Compare a written script to a filmed or live performance
Evaluate directorial choices made in a production
Justify personal interpretation of a script moment

title.fr: Bases de la conception et de la technique théâtrale

summary.en: Learners explore how set, costume, lighting and sound support storytelling, and try simple design tasks to enhance a performance.
summary.fr: Les élèves explorent comment le décor, le costume, l'éclairage et le son soutiennent la narration, et essaient des tâches de conception simples pour améliorer une représentation.
summary.mfe: Bann elev explor kouma dekor, kostim, lekleraz ek son sipport rakontaz enn zistwar, ek esey bann tas konsepsion senp pou amelior enn perfomans.

title.en: The role of set and props
title.fr: Le rôle du décor et des accessoires

objectives: Explain how set pieces suggest location and mood
Design a simple set layout for a scene
Select props that support character and story
Identify how costume communicates character traits
Design a costume idea for a given role
Discuss costume choices in a Mauritian context
Describe how lighting affects audience emotion
Suggest lighting choices for different scene moods
Experiment with basic lighting effects using simple tools

title.fr: Le son et la musique dans la représentation

objectives: Identify how sound effects support a scene
Select music that fits a scene's atmosphere
Create a simple soundscape for a short scene

summary.en: Students use their bodies expressively to tell stories without relying only on words, exploring mime, ensemble movement and physical storytelling.
summary.fr: Les élèves utilisent leur corps de manière expressive pour raconter des histoires sans dépendre uniquement des mots, explorant le mime, le mouvement d'ensemble et la narration physique.
summary.mfe: Bann elev servi zot lekor dan enn fason expresif pou rakont zistwar san depann zis lor bann mo, explor mim, mouvman an group ek rakontaz fizik.

objectives: Use gesture and expression to convey meaning without words
Create an object or environment using mime
Perform a short mime sequence to a small audience
Move in synchrony with a group
Create shapes and formations to represent ideas
Reflect on the impact of unified group movement

summary.en: In this culminating unit, students plan, rehearse and present a final performance piece, then reflect critically on their own and others' work.
summary.fr: Dans cette unité finale, les élèves planifient, répètent et présentent une pièce de performance finale, puis réfléchissent de manière critique à leur propre travail et à celui des autres.
summary.mfe: Dan sa lini final-la, bann elev planifie, repete ek prezant enn dernie pyes perfomans, apre reflesi dan enn fason kritik lor zot prop travay ek lor travay lezot.

objectives: Choose a theme, script or devised idea for a final piece
Assign roles and set a rehearsal schedule
Outline staging, design and technical needs
Apply feedback to improve a scene during rehearsal
Run a scene multiple times to build consistency
Solve staging problems collaboratively
Perform a final piece with focus and commitment
Manage nerves and stay in role during performance
Support fellow performers during the presentation
Evaluate strengths and areas for improvement in own performance
Give constructive feedback on peers' performances
Set personal goals for future drama work

summary.en: Students revisit key drama skills from earlier grades and begin exploring the devising process used in IGCSE Drama, learning how stimulus material can generate original performance ideas.
summary.fr: Les élèves révisent les compétences théâtrales essentielles des années précédentes et commencent à explorer le processus de création utilisé en théâtre IGCSE, en apprenant comment un stimulus peut générer des idées de performance originales.
summary.mfe: Bann elev pas an revi bann konpetans teat baz ki zot fin aprann avan, ek koumans explor prosesis pou kre enn pyes teat kouma dan IGCSE Drama, an aprann kouman enn stimulis kapav donn lide pou performans orizinal.

objectives: Recall key drama conventions learnt in earlier grades
Demonstrate basic stagecraft vocabulary
Apply warm-up techniques used in professional rehearsal
Identify different types of stimulus used to inspire drama
Analyse a stimulus for dramatic potential
Generate initial ideas from a given stimulus
Explain the stages of devising a piece of theatre
Collaborate in small groups to shape ideas
Reflect on group decision-making during devising
Sequence dramatic action logically
Use structure to build tension in a scene
Evaluate the effectiveness of a scene's structure

summary.en: This unit develops students' physical expression through movement-based exercises, exploring how the body communicates character, emotion and narrative on stage.
summary.fr: Cette unité développe l'expression physique des élèves à travers des exercices basés sur le mouvement, en explorant comment le corps communique le personnage, l'émotion et le récit sur scène.
summary.mfe: Sa linite-la devlop lexpresyon fizik bann elev atraver exersis baze lor mouvman, an explor kouman lekor kominik personaz, santiman ek istwar lor lasenn.

title.mfe: Lekor kouma zouti pou rakont istwar

objectives: Use posture and gesture to convey meaning

Discuss how physicality supports narrative
Apply techniques such as mime and choral movement
Create a short physical sequence in groups
Evaluate peer physical theatre pieces

Experiment with tempo and rhythm in movement

title.fr: Explorer un texte par la performance

summary.en: Students study extracts from set and unseen play scripts, learning to interpret dialogue, subtext and stage directions to bring text to life.
summary.fr: Les élèves étudient des extraits de scripts de pièces prescrites et inconnues, apprenant à interpréter le dialogue, le sous-texte et les indications scéniques pour donner vie au texte.
summary.mfe: Bann elev etidye bann extre depi pyes teat fikse ek pa'nn fikse, an aprann interprete dyalog, sou-tex ek direksyon lasenn pou donn lavi ar tex.

objectives: Identify structural features of a play script
Distinguish between dialogue and stage directions
Discuss the playwright's intentions in a set text

title.fr: Trouver le sous-texte dans le dialogue

objectives: Explain the concept of subtext
Perform a scene emphasising unspoken meaning
Compare different interpretations of the same line
Follow written stage directions accurately
Adapt stage directions to a performance space
Justify directorial choices when interpreting text
Rehearse a short scripted extract in pairs
Apply vocal and physical skills to scripted performance
Reflect on strengths and areas for improvement

summary.en: This unit focuses on techniques for creating believable characters, including physical, vocal and psychological approaches to role-building.
summary.fr: Cette unité se concentre sur les techniques de création de personnages crédibles, y compris les approches physiques, vocales et psychologiques de la construction de rôle.
summary.mfe: Sa linite-la konsantre lor teknik pou kre personaz kredib, ki inklir bann laprosh fizik, vokal ek psikolozik pou konstrir rol.

objectives: Research background details to build a character
Identify a character's motivations and objectives
Create a written character profile
Experiment with pitch, pace and tone for character voice
Apply accent and dialect appropriately
Evaluate vocal choices in performance
Use posture and movement to define a character

title.fr: Interview de personnage et exploration du rôle

objectives: Answer improvised questions in role

title.fr: Éléments de conception dans la performance

summary.en: Students explore how lighting, sound, costume and set design contribute to the overall meaning and atmosphere of a performance.
summary.fr: Les élèves explorent comment l'éclairage, le son, les costumes et la scénographie contribuent au sens global et à l'atmosphère d'une performance.
summary.mfe: Bann elev explor kouman lalimyer, son, kostim ek design lasenn kontribye dan sinifikasyon global ek atmosfer enn performans.

objectives: Identify key elements of stage design

Describe how lighting affects audience perception
Experiment with lighting choices for a scene

title.fr: Son et musique dans la performance

objectives: Select sound effects to enhance a scene
Explore the use of music to build atmosphere
Evaluate the impact of sound choices
Analyse how costume conveys character information
Design a costume concept for a role

summary.en: This unit develops confidence in spontaneous performance while linking improvisational skills to structured, scripted drama work.
summary.fr: Cette unité développe la confiance dans la performance spontanée tout en reliant les compétences d'improvisation au travail théâtral scénarisé et structuré.
summary.mfe: Sa linite-la devlop konfyans dan performans spontane pandan ki li relye konpetans improvizasyon avek travay teat skripte ek striktire.

objectives: Apply the 'yes and' principle in improvisation

summary.en: Students consolidate skills by rehearsing a polished performance piece and learning to critically evaluate their own and others' theatrical work.
summary.fr: Les élèves consolident leurs compétences en répétant une performance soignée et en apprenant à évaluer de manière critique leur propre travail théâtral et celui des autres.
summary.mfe: Bann elev konsolid zot konpetans an repete enn pyes performans fini bien prepare ek an aprann evalye kritikman zot prop travay teat ek sa lezot osi.

objectives: Plan an effective rehearsal schedule
Use rehearsal notes to improve performance
Apply feedback constructively during rehearsal
Demonstrate performance skills in front of peers

summary.en: Students revise key drama skills from earlier grades and build ensemble trust needed for Cambridge IGCSE Drama coursework.
summary.fr: Les élèves révisent les compétences théâtrales clés des années précédentes et développent la confiance de groupe nécessaire pour le travail de coursework IGCSE Cambridge.
summary.mfe: Bann elev revize bann konpetans teat kle ki zwenn nan bann klas avan e devlop konfyans an group ki neseser pou travay coursework Cambridge IGCSE Drama.

objectives: Recall vocal and physical warm-up techniques

summary.en: Students learn the devising process, from stimulus to structured performance, developing original material collaboratively.

objectives: Document the devising journey in a working log

summary.en: Students study a set play text in depth, exploring character, context and dramatic meaning to prepare for practical exploration.
